steps.note: Start the single-stage create flow required for choosing an auction strategy.
Apply the first available auction pricing template.
Add one product for both vendors to bid on.
Populate the pricing sheet before scheduling and publishing.
Invite two vendors so their bids can be compared.
Publish the auction so vendors can bid.
Confirm the auction reached a published project page.
Confirm the trailing vendor's bid was accepted.
Confirm the leading vendor's bid was accepted.
View the auction from the configured vendor portal, intended to be the first bid's trailing vendor.
Open the live auction bid sheet in the vendor portal.
Assert that the trailing vendor receives rank feedback showing L2.
Assert that the known competitor bid value is not exposed to the trailing vendor.
